# adeahub

> adeahub is a digital health platform that connects patient apps, hospital information systems, health data exchange and analytics for hospitals, health systems and ministries of health across Asia, the Middle East and Africa.

Key facts: 35M+ users on the platform, 8,500+ health facilities, 200M+ patient records, 17+ locations, 25+ years of healthcare IT heritage. Parent company: entomo.

## Products

- [AH Engage](https://adeahub.co/ah-engage/): AH Engage is patient engagement software that connects patients to their care team before, during and after every visit, with 60,000+ appointments booked daily.
- [AH Care](https://adeahub.co/ah-care/): AH Care is a fully integrated hospital information system for clinical and administrative workflows, proven in HIMSS EMRAM Stage 7 hospitals across the region.
- [AH Connect](https://adeahub.co/ah-connect/): AH Connect is a vendor-neutral FHIR R4 interoperability platform with an integration engine, FHIR server and API gateway, powering Egypt's national HIE.
- [AH Insights](https://adeahub.co/ah-insights/): Real-time healthcare analytics and population health management for hospitals and ministries of health, with 200+ standardised KPIs and AI-powered insights.
- [AH Outbreak Management](https://adeahub.co/ah-outbreak-management/): Detect, trace, monitor and contain infectious disease outbreaks. AH Outbreak Management is proven in national pandemic response in Malaysia and the UAE.
- [WorkWise](https://adeahub.co/workwise/): WorkWise by entomo is the healthcare workforce experience platform for performance, smart scheduling, career development and staff wellness in health systems.
